scope.question: Does a checksum-valid CanonicalQuadratureEvidence built from caller-supplied metric rows itself prove that a real independent registered 24/48/96 quadrature run occurred?
scope.reason: The audited builder binds supplied values and identities, but it sets convergence_assessed and independent_of_training_and_held_in_selection to true internally without accepting or binding a distinct execution/producer provenance receipt. The checksum proves receipt integrity, not how the metric rows were generated.

user_requirement: Keep user requirements, public-source facts, autonomous design, and pending/unknown separate.
Keep velocity_export_ready, visual_correspondence_verified, pde_validated, and paper_exact independent.
Do not relax the registered PDE thresholds, allow residual-defined free forcing, or permit amplitude collapse.
autonomous_design: PR #903's CanonicalQuadratureEvidence schema and checksum binding are repository-autonomous validation infrastructure.
This audit's fabricated metric-row witness is a mechanics/provenance witness only and is not Kokuno/OpenAI candidate evidence.
A future execution-provenance receipt may use any fail-closed schema that binds the real producer/run identity; this audit does not prescribe a paper-source format.
pending_unknown: No real complete Kokuno black-box candidate is currently available for canonical 24/48/96 quadrature admission.
No real canonical 24/48/96 Kokuno execution receipt is currently registered here.
Independent producer/run provenance for future quadrature metric rows remains to be implemented or otherwise independently evidenced.
Kokuno pde_validated, visual correspondence, paper exactness, and OpenAI-field identity remain unverified.

checksum_valid_receipt_may_claim: the serialized receipt payload is internally checksum-consistent
the recorded candidate/contract/operator/protocol/ladder identities match the verifier's expected identities when the verifier accepts them
the recorded numerical rows pass the encoded numerical gate checks
checksum_valid_receipt_may_not_claim_wit: the metric rows were actually produced by an independent canonical 24/48/96 quadrature run
the metric rows were independent of training or held-in model selection merely because the builder-set boolean is true
the convergence assessment was independently performed merely because the builder-set boolean is true
pde_validated is scientifically established from self-authored rows alone

minimum_binding_semantics: producer or workflow/run identity distinct from the metric-row checksum itself
artifact or output digest covering the actual per-level numerical outputs
independence statement whose provenance is external to build_canonical_quadrature_evidence's hard-coded booleans
